title: Cessna 172 pilot with no training, no hours, only flight simulator experience. Takeoff and landing
summary: A man with no flight instruction and only desktop flight simulator experience attempts to take off and land a Cessna 172, with a commercial airline instructor aboard who gives no help. The flight came out of a prop bet.
why: HN cites it as real evidence for whether a non-pilot can land a plane, whenever the topic comes up.
topic: landing a plane with simulator experience
